title: The Jackass Trophy: Inside Musk v. Altman
caption:
A 'jackass trophy' in a high-stakes AI courtroom. Sam Altman's team brought a literal award inscribed with a provocative message, setting a bizarre tone for the Musk v. Altman trial.

Here's what happened.

Tap the link in bio and BUILD for the field guide.

slides.headline: The trophy nobody saw coming in the OpenAI courtroom.
slides.sub: A peek at the drama behind the most public AI feud.

slides.title: The Unveiling
slides.body: Before jurors entered the Musk v. Altman courtroom, Sam Altman's team presented an unexpected item: a small trophy. It was passed up, initially appearing like a child's sports award.

slides.definition: A commemorative award, reportedly purchased by OpenAI employees, bearing the inscription: 'Never stop being a jackass.'
slides.example: The trophy was read aloud to the press, setting a defiant tone for the proceedings.

slides.title: Altman's Calculated Move
bullets: A direct jab at Elon Musk's public persona and ongoing legal challenge.
Framing the legal battle as a clash of personalities, not just corporate dispute.
Signaling OpenAI's confidence and willingness to engage provocatively.
slides.footer: The trophy was a calculated psychological play.

slides.title: Musk v. Altman
slides.body: The trophy incident underscores the high-stakes legal battle between Elon Musk and Sam Altman. Musk's suit alleges OpenAI deviated from its original non-profit, open-source mission.

slides.title: Setting the Tone
slides.body: Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers had the inscription read aloud for the press. This public display ensured the trophy's message resonated beyond the courtroom, impacting public perception of the trial.

slides.hook: This is just one skirmish in the larger AI battle. Stay ahead.
